summary: This note is a short biographical entry on James H. Schwartz. It states that he was born in Ottumwa, Iowa, attended Creighton University, and worked in the insurance industry. It also records that he served in the Iowa House of Representatives as a Democrat from 1969 to 1973.
one_line: Biographical note on James H. Schwartz, an Iowa Democrat who served in the Iowa House of Representatives from 1969 to 1973.
